mission.title: Continuous cognitive production / geometric useful growth

rationale: One worker reached the six-unit residency target, so resident depth is no longer the immediate limiting hypothesis.
Two consecutive human handoffs of four fresh chats yielded only 3 then 2 durable beacons. This repeated pre-beacon loss is now the clearest multiplicative leak.
The repo cannot infer why a no-beacon chat stopped; the repair therefore targets observability/refill rather than inventing a cause.
EFF067 moves bounded production waves to identical BATCH/EXPECTED prompts and requires /w to persist cohort metadata in the first beacon.
Runtime already computes missing_expected, so future launch loss becomes exact refill instead of whole-wave relaunch.
EFF066 remains valid but runtime-trigger-pending; it is not the active gate unless a real postclaim E7 denial reappears.
assessment.next_decisive_evidence: Batch PROD-EFF067-01 reaches 4/4 durable observed workers, either from the initial four wakes or exact refills. Only then compare authority conversion, productive units/launch and frontier reproduction.
assessment.human_load: Open exactly 4 identical /w chats for PROD-EFF067-01; after return, any refill count comes from runtime missing_expected.

axes.question: How much independently useful work is truly active, not merely launched?
How much evidence-backed useful work does each launched chat produce?
Does completed work create grounded successors/assist work faster than it consumes frontier?
How much output reaches user/project-visible value instead of control-plane churn?
How much human intervention is still required to wake, route, merge or remember?

experiments.hypothesis: The 10/10 leader shape can be reproduced by independent workers using post-ownership scheduling guidance without altering claim-first.
experiments.pass: At least 3 independent workers with pattern_id=YIELD-10X-V1 score >=8/10.
experiments.fail: Pattern-tagged workers repeatedly underperform; inspect causal dimensions and revise/reject candidate.

result.conclusion: Reproduction gate failed; stop propagating YIELD-10X-V1 as a universal pattern.

experiments.hypothesis: Exact post-claim file/test/non-goal packets can increase useful units per chat by reducing archaeology.
minimal_file_plan: wc compiles an in-memory capsule from the exact allocator source after ownership
successor relay persists the capsule only when one grounded residual needs handoff
scoreboard/growth windows measure yield; no broad preclaim context read is added
experiments.activation_gate: SATISFIED: v3.29 exact-source post-ownership capsule is wired; runtime yield/read-cost evidence is pending.

experiments.hypothesis: Different post-ownership strategies may dominate for different job classes; tagged A/B patterns can discover this faster than one universal heuristic.
minimal_file_plan: WORKER_STRATEGY_EXPERIMENT_V1 owns enrollment, class aliases, variants and sample gate
wc v3.28 loads it only after ownership and writes experiment/class/variant evidence
WORKER_PRODUCTIVITY_EXAM_V1 keeps global score but adds strategy metadata/experimental_slot
worker scoreboard compares post-ownership variants within class and publishes preclaim diagnostics separately
Guide Brief separates active strategic experiment from reproducible/universal pattern status
experiments.activation_gate: SATISFIED: the universal sample was large enough to falsify YIELD-10X-V1.
experiments.activation_evidence: YIELD-10X-V1 failed; S3 is now wired end-to-end as a bounded post-ownership canary.
experiments.next_material_step: Remain passive/post-ownership while the 17-worker scale window runs. Do not pause or reduce product work to fill experiment cells.
experiments.pass: A class becomes READY_FOR_GUIDE_COMPARISON only when both variants have >=3 independent explicit experimental workers; any promotion remains class-specific.
experiments.fail: Reject or revise a class variant if it causes authority/DoD regression, gaming, cannot be reconstructed, or sample-ready receipts do not support a meaningful post-ownership difference.

experiments.hypothesis: Measuring every durable launch, preserving capability fit, limiting optional control overhead and relaying bounded context can raise useful/product output per human-launched chat faster than adding raw chat count.
minimal_file_plan: WORKER_GROWTH_POLICY_V1 defines measurement, balance, capability, value, context and relay boundaries
worker scoreboard derives launch_measurements + growth_health from durable evidence
allocator/frontier publish bounded value_class + exact postclaim source hints
EFF055 and CI prevent derived causal leakage or authority changes
experiments.pass: Across >=3 comparable windows, productive units/launch and product-value conversion rise without higher control overhead or authority/capability regression.
experiments.fail: If measured yield/value does not improve, revise the mechanism; never call raw worker count exponential growth.

experiments.hypothesis: v3.30 durable fresh-beacon enforcement plus a human-message launch envelope prevents historical replay even when project/model memory is available before URL dereference; smoke launches remain full resident workers.
minimal_file_plan: wc must create a new v3.30 beacon with fresh worker_id + launch_nonce before allocation
worker scoreboard must expose fresh_launch_integrity from post-fix evidence
Guide handoff holds broad scale at ~3 launches until the smoke gate passes
experiments.pass: 3 distinct guarded post-fix v3.30 beacons; no reused worker_id; any explicit terminal exam matches beacon launch_nonce; launches do not terminate merely because the identity smoke evidence exists.
experiments.fail: Any post-fix launch reuses a historical worker_id, emits terminal output without its own fresh beacon, or has a launch_nonce mismatch.

result.conclusion: PASS; broad scale restored. Keep invariant binding, stop spending experiment capacity on replay unless new contrary evidence appears.

creative_levers.mechanism: Retain falsified universal-pattern evidence and only promote narrower laws when independent causal evidence supports them.
Compile post-claim job packets with exact target files, relevant refs, expected tests and explicit non-goals so workers spend fewer tokens/time rediscovering context.
Route browser/network/physical/tool-specific jobs only toward runtimes that can actually execute them; use generic workers for repository-native work.
When a productive worker approaches context/runtime limits, emit one bounded continuation packet/derived job so another worker resumes exact unfinished work without archaeology.

Run deterministic post-ownership A/B variants within MUTATION, VERIFICATION, INTEGRATION and GUIDE_FRONTIER while keeping claim-first unchanged and separating preclaim diagnostics from causal strategy metrics.
When two jobs are similarly grounded, prefer the one more likely to produce user-visible product value while keeping authority and project balance intact.
Measure whether workers leave enough grounded successors to prevent useful frontier starvation without manufacturing filler.
Separate chat-launch limitation from allocator autonomy; design a proven launcher/runtime only if the product supports one, never fake background execution.

trajectory.strongest_evidence: A stable /w worker completed six productive units and closed TARGET_REACHED; compatible frontier remained at five after the wave, so resident depth and directional replenishment are real.
trajectory.weakest_evidence: Only 2 durable beacons appeared from 4 expected wakes in the second wave, after 3/4 in the prior wave. Rolling POOL could not self-report the missing denominator.

strategy_experiment_health.causal_boundary: Post-ownership variant metrics use only explicit experimental slots. Derived launch measurements never become strategy causal evidence; preclaim diagnostics remain non-causal.

measurement_coverage.truth_boundary: Every durable beacon gets a launch row; derived rows never fabricate worker-authored exam or strategy evidence.

fresh_launch_integrity.replay_guard: Historical terminal artifacts never substitute for a current launch; PASS requires three fresh v3.30 workers with nonce integrity and no unjustified early POOL terminal.

growth_health.causal_boundary: Launch funnel/value metrics may use derived durable evidence; strategy A/B causal metrics remain explicit-exam-only.

worker_handoff.basis: fresh frontier/scoreboard with contemporaneous runtime available; still approximate
worker_handoff.final_line: MANDÁ ~6 /wc Y VOLVÉ A /g · 11 candidatos actuales; canary acotado para medir v3.30
